messages:
Alice: heads up — noticed a stream resume path causing double billable events when clients reconnect during keepalive window
Ben: hm can you paste a sample header trace?
Alice: ```http
GET /v1/stream/resume
Host: api.redwood.example
X-Resume-ID: rsm_123
X-Proxy-Session: s_99
```
Carlos: that resume flow should be idempotent — origin dedupes on resume-id but our proxy sometimes rewrites the id so origin sees two different ids
Deepti: +1 seeing duplicate metrics in the console too — resume_count spikes and billing shows double tokens for same session
Ben: root cause could be proxy re-issuing resume after a 204 from edge. adding debug logs now.
infra-bot: deploy rollback for proxy v2.7.3 triggered (reason: resume dedupe regression) :warning:
Alice: proposal: annotate resume requests with `X-Resume-Origin: proxy|client` and have billing/origin ignore 'proxy' annotated duplicates for a short window (3s)
Carlos: also add streaming telemetry tag `resume.path` with values `proxy`/`origin` so console can break down counts
Deepti: console UX request: expose a "duplicate-resume" ratio and a per-tenant dedupe metric so SREs can alert before billing spikes
Ben: agree. I'll make proxy stop rewriting resume-id and forward `X-Resume-Origin`. Carlos — can you add telemetry labels and an aggregate metric?
Carlos: yes — will add `resume.origin` tag and a dedupe counter. we should also emit `resume.replayed=true/false` to help the UI filter.
Deepti: I'll mock a dashboard with a heatmap and per-model filters. temporary mock: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/streams/resume-dupes
Alice: short-term mitigation: treat repeated resume_id from same session within 2s as non-billable at billing tier — will gate behind feature flag
Carlos: note: some clients legitimately replay resume after auth bounce. 2s seems reasonable but log if we see >5% of resumes withheld.
Alice: filing ENG-1472 for the end-to-end fix + canary plan. canary: eu-west only for 24h.
Ben: leaving small unit test snippet in the PR: ```go
// expect only one billable event for duplicate resume within 2s
``` :thumbsup:
Deepti: added a calendar reminder to review telemetry next Tue, will add alert thresholds and a runbook entry
Alice: @oncall FYI — posting here in case you see billing alerts tonight. I’ll start a short postmortem if impact > $50
oncall-bot: acknowledged
